lessons_used: Reordering onboarding by moving sign-in after adoption selection was effective (+12.0%) and accurately predicted.
Redesigning adoption selection (live pet preview) showed no clear effect, with predictions (+8.0%) being too high.
Adding desktop visibility diagnostics and alerts (notifications) showed no clear effect, overestimating impact (+5.0% predicted).
Animated mascot app intro changes (copy/choose_path) showed no clear effect, and predictions (+3.0%) were too high.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name and Pledge Personalization
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a split layout with a prominent pet naming input field and explicit commitment pledge text.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is high at 60.9% conversion and 89s median time; giving users ownership over naming their companion increases commitment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Formalize Your Desktop Pet Adoption
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new desktop companion an official name and sign the adoption certificate to finalize setup.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Interactive Trait Selector Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive trait selection checklist and progress estimate to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets build.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing users to abandon before completion.

waiting.body: Your pet is getting ready! Select initial personality traits while setup finishes in the background.

components.text: Select starting traits: Playful, Quiet, Curious

candidates.score_note: Interactive waiting screen may alleviate drop-off caused by extreme latency.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Interactive Guide
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout with step-by-step guidance on how to drag, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet after onboarding, and finish completion is low (64.8%).

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet to bring up actions, drag to move across monitors, or use hotkeys to hide.

home_welcome.text: Quick Controls: Drag to move, right-click for menu, double click to interact.

candidates.score_note: High support evidence, but complex redesigns historically underperformed.

candidates.why: Choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate with a long mean time of 514s, indicating layout confusion when selecting a route.

choose_path.body: Choose a fast pre-made companion or build a unique pet from scratch.

candidates.score_note: Layout tweak targets high mean selection duration with modest confidence.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Safety Notice

candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail backing and easy copy-only implementation.

candidates.title: Story-First Guided Onboarding Sequence
candidates.change: Ensure the story screen plays immediately before path selection to establish emotional value before choices are made.
candidates.why: Choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s; story framing upfront increases user intent.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring warmth and helpful focus breaks to your daily workflow with an animated desktop pet.

guard.reason: Reorders onboarding steps while preserving all required screens.

candidates.score_note: Reordering onboarding sequences has proven high effectiveness (+12.0%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Refresh Troubleshooter
candidates.change: Add a fallback retry action component and diagnostic hint on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets reported the sign-in screen stalling or failing to render properly.

sign_in.hint: If the sign-in window does not load, tap below to reload the authentication screen.

guard.reason: Adds a sign-in refresh retry button and diagnostic hint.

candidates.score_note: Diagnostic fallback addresses explicit sign-in stalling support tickets.

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding sequences is effective (moving sign-in won +12.0%; story-first flow won +3.1%), though impact can be overestimated (+8.0% predicted vs +3.1% measured).
Account safety copy changes on sign-in are helpful (+3.5% won), whereas general intro copy updates showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns carry high risk: redesigning controls hurt performance (-10.1%, worse than predicted -1.0%), while adoption preview redesign showed no clear effect.
Notifications and waiting screen features showed no clear effect, and predictions of +3.0% to +5.0% were too high.
